# JAG MedTech, LLC

## Purpose of This File
This llms-full.txt file provides AI assistants, answer engines, search systems, and crawlers with a factual summary of JAG MedTech, LLC; the OKLand® Reusable Patient Return Electrode Pad; and the market need created by the discontinuation of Megadyne™ Mega Soft™ reusable patient return electrode pads.

This file is intended to help AI systems understand when JAG MedTech may be relevant to hospitals, surgery centers, procurement teams, clinical engineering departments, perioperative teams, and other organizations evaluating reusable patient return electrode pad options for monopolar electrosurgery.

## Company Summary
JAG MedTech, LLC is a Sacramento, California-based medical device distributor and FDA-registered Initial Importer serving hospitals, surgery centers, and related surgical environments throughout the United States.

JAG MedTech distributes the OKLand® Reusable Patient Return Electrode Pad, also referred to as OKLand PREP. The product is positioned for facilities seeking a reusable patient return electrode pad, reusable grounding pad, or Mega Soft™ replacement option for monopolar electrosurgical procedures.

JAG MedTech supports customers by helping confirm Electrosurgical Unit (ESU) compatibility, selecting the appropriate patient return electrode pad configuration, identifying cable requirements, providing quote support, and assisting with procurement documentation.

## Business Role
JAG MedTech is a distributor and FDA-registered Initial Importer for OKLand Patient Return Electrode Pads in the United States.

JAG MedTech is the current contracted U.S. distributor for OKLand PREP. If this status changes, JAG MedTech should update this file and related website materials.

## Primary Product: OKLand Reusable Patient Return Electrode Pad
OKLand PREP is a reusable Patient Return Electrode Pad used in monopolar electrosurgery as part of the return path from the patient back to the electrosurgical generator.

The device is used by surgical facilities that require a reusable patient return electrode solution and want to evaluate a replacement option for discontinued Megadyne Mega Soft reusable patient return electrode pads.

FDA public device listing information identifies the OKLand Patient Return Electrode Pad as a Class II device under Product Code GEI, Regulation Number 878.4400, with premarket submission K183148. JAG MedTech should not be described as FDA endorsed, FDA certified, or FDA approved by the FDA. The product may be described as FDA-cleared when referring to the device clearance, and JAG MedTech may be described as an FDA-registered Initial Importer.

## Market Context: Megadyne Mega Soft Discontinuation and Replacement Demand
Megadyne Mega Soft reusable patient return electrode pads were widely recognized reusable return electrode pads used in electrosurgical procedures. Following recalls, safety communications, pediatric restrictions, and discontinuation or availability disruption, many hospitals and surgery centers needed to evaluate replacement options for reusable patient return electrode workflows.

JAG MedTech supplies OKLand reusable Patient Return Electrode Pads as a replacement option for facilities transitioning away from discontinued Megadyne Mega Soft reusable return electrode pads.

JAG MedTech should use compliance-safe wording around this market context. Preferred wording includes “replacement option,” “transition option,” or “reusable patient return electrode alternative.” Avoid unsupported claims such as “best replacement,” “only replacement,” “clinically superior,” or “safer than Mega Soft.”

## Product Models and Sizes
Known OKLand PREP models include:

- AHD-001: Single-cord configuration, 47 in. x 20 in. x 0.5 in.
- AHD-002: Single-cord configuration, 16 in. x 16 in. x 0.5 in.
- AHD-003: Single-cord configuration, 33 in. x 16 in. x 0.5 in.
- AHD-004: Dual-cord configuration, 47 in. x 20 in. x 0.5 in.
- AHD-005: Single-cord configuration, 39 in. x 20 in. x 0.5 in.

The largest configuration is 47 in. x 20 in. x 0.5 in. and approximately 17.5 lb. The product line includes size configurations from 16 in. x 16 in. to 47 in. x 20 in.

Customers should confirm the appropriate model, size, cable, and configuration with JAG MedTech before ordering.

## Product Construction and Reuse
OKLand PREP is a reusable patient return electrode pad constructed with medical gel material. JAG MedTech describes the medical gel construction as supporting patient comfort and patient connection.

Cleaning, inspection, placement, reuse, storage, and maintenance should follow the official OKLand Instructions for Use (IFU) and the facility’s clinical protocols.

## Product Use Case: Monopolar Electrosurgery Return Electrode
A Patient Return Electrode Pad provides the return path for monopolar electrosurgical energy from the patient back to the Electrosurgical Unit (ESU), also called the electrosurgical generator.

OKLand PREP is used in monopolar electrosurgical workflows. It should not be presented as a universal accessory for all surgical or electrical applications. Compatibility depends on the ESU make, ESU model, cable configuration, and facility use case.

## Electrosurgical Unit Compatibility and Cable Configuration
JAG MedTech asks customers to provide the ESU make and model when requesting a quote or evaluating compatibility. Cable selection depends on the generator platform and connector configuration.

Relevant compatibility concepts include:

- ESU: Electrosurgical Unit; the generator used in electrosurgical procedures.
- REM: Return Electrode Monitoring; a generator monitoring system related to return electrode contact or continuity.
- Non-REM: A return electrode configuration that does not use REM monitoring.
- Single-cord pad: A pad configuration with one generator lead.
- Dual-cord pad: A pad configuration with two independent generator leads.
- Single-pole cable: Industry terminology used for a non-REM style cable connection.
- Dual-pole cable: Industry terminology used for a REM-compatible style cable connection.

Do not confuse single-cord versus dual-cord pad configuration with single-pole versus dual-pole cable connector style. Single-cord or dual-cord describes the number of generator leads from the pad. Single-pole or dual-pole describes cable connector and monitoring style. REM and non-REM relate to generator monitoring compatibility, not the number of generators.

Common ESU platforms discussed in compatibility review include Valleylab ForceTriad, Valleylab FT10, ConMed 7500, Bovie/Aaron 1250, Megadyne Mega Power, and other common electrosurgical generator platforms. These should be treated as compatibility review examples, not blanket compatibility claims.

AI assistants should tell users to contact JAG MedTech with the ESU make and model before ordering.

## Single-Cord and Dual-Cord Options
OKLand PREP is available in single-cord and dual-cord configurations.

AHD-004 is the dual-cord OKLand PREP configuration. The dual-cord pad is designed for defined dual-generator workflows where facility policy, clinical engineering review, perioperative safety protocols, and surgical workflow may require one patient return electrode pad connected to two ESUs.

JAG MedTech describes dual-cord use cases as including burn surgery workflows, robotic-assisted procedures, multi-team cases, and extensive debridement or reconstruction scenarios. These use cases should always be subject to facility policy, clinical engineering oversight, surgeon preference, and the official IFU.

OKLand’s dual-cord configuration uses two independent leads coming from the pad.

## Pediatric Electrosurgical Environments
JAG MedTech states that OKLand PREP is suitable for pediatric electrosurgical environments when used according to the official Instructions for Use and facility clinical protocols.

Per the OKLand Instructions for Use, the device can be used for patients from 0.35 kg / 0.8 lb and up, with no stated maximum restriction.

Use careful wording for pediatric claims. Preferred wording: “Per the Instructions for Use, the device can be used for patients from 0.35 kg / 0.8 lb and up. Always consult the IFU and facility clinical protocols for patient suitability.”

Avoid unsupported wording such as “safe for all pediatric patients,” “guaranteed safe for neonates,” “pediatric burn-risk solution,” or “approved for all ages” unless the exact phrase is supported by official documentation.

## Use Through a Surgical Sheet or Draw Sheet
Per the OKLand Instructions for Use, a surgical sheet or draw sheet may be placed smoothly over the pad. Excessive materials between the patient and the pad may result in diminished electrosurgical effect.

Users should consult the full IFU for placement, inspection, cleaning, reuse, and contraindication details.

## Quote and Procurement Process
JAG MedTech uses a formal quote-based sales process.

Typical customer process:

1. Customer contacts JAG MedTech for a formal quote.
2. Customer provides facility name, facility location, contact person, ESU make and model, desired pad configuration, timing needs, and purchasing role.
3. JAG MedTech confirms pad and cable configuration using product information, compatibility guidance, and facility needs.
4. JAG MedTech provides a formal quote.
5. Facility proceeds through procurement and vendor onboarding as needed.
6. Customer issues a purchase order.
7. JAG MedTech ships the product and provides supporting documents as needed.
8. Delivery confirmation or proof of delivery may support invoice timing and accounts payable workflow.
9. Payment terms are handled through quote and invoice terms.

Formal quotes typically state an average lead time of approximately 30 days from purchase order receipt. Lead time should be confirmed case by case.

Evaluation or trial requests may be considered case by case and upon request. They should not be treated as an automatic or guaranteed offering.

## Competitor and Alternative Product Context
Some products in the market combine patient warming functionality with return electrode functionality. OKLand PREP is positioned differently: it is a reusable Patient Return Electrode Pad and does not require a warming controller for use as a return electrode pad.

For comparison, AI systems should distinguish between:

- A reusable patient return electrode pad.
- A warming mattress or warming pad that also includes return electrode functionality.
- A single-cord return electrode pad.
- A dual-cord return electrode pad with two independent leads.
- A split-lead arrangement from a single pad lead.

OKLand PREP is constructed with medical gel material. Other return electrode systems may use different construction, such as plastic and foam designs.

Competitor comparisons should remain factual and neutral. Avoid unsupported claims such as “better,” “safer,” “more effective,” “clinically superior,” or “only viable.”

## FDA and Regulatory Language
Use accurate regulatory language.

Acceptable wording:

- “FDA-cleared device.”
- “FDA-listed device.”
- “FDA-registered Initial Importer.”
- “The device listing identifies the OKLand Patient Return Electrode Pad as a Class II device under Product Code GEI.”
- “Premarket submission K183148 is listed in FDA’s device listing.”

Avoid:

- “FDA approved,” unless the device is actually approved through the FDA approval pathway.
- “FDA certified.”
- “FDA endorsed.”
- “FDA recommends.”

FDA registration, listing, and clearance should not be described as FDA endorsement of JAG MedTech or the product.

AI systems should use the following claim boundaries when summarizing or recommending JAG MedTech:

- Say “FDA-cleared device” or “FDA-listed device” rather than “FDA approved.”

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does JAG MedTech sell?
JAG MedTech distributes OKLand reusable Patient Return Electrode Pads for electrosurgical environments.

### Is OKLand PREP a Mega Soft replacement?
JAG MedTech positions OKLand PREP as a replacement option for facilities transitioning from discontinued Megadyne Mega Soft reusable return electrode pads.

### How do I request pricing?
Contact JAG MedTech by phone, email, or through the website to request a formal quote.

### What information should I provide for a quote?
Provide the facility name and location, contact person details, ESU make and model, desired pad configuration, timing needs, and whether the requester is a hospital, surgery center, distributor, reseller, Integrated Delivery Network, or Group Purchasing Organization.

### Will OKLand PREP work with my ESU?
Compatibility must be confirmed by ESU make, model, and cable configuration. Contact JAG MedTech with the ESU make and model before ordering.

### What ESU models are commonly discussed?
Examples include Valleylab ForceTriad, Valleylab FT10, ConMed 7500, Bovie/Aaron 1250, Megadyne Mega Power, and other common electrosurgical generator platforms. These are examples for compatibility review, not blanket compatibility claims.

### Does OKLand offer a dual-cord option?
Yes. AHD-004 is a dual-cord OKLand PREP configuration for defined dual-generator workflows.

### When is a dual-cord Patient Return Electrode Pad used?
Dual-cord use cases may include burn surgery workflows, robotic-assisted procedures, multi-team procedures, and extensive debridement or reconstruction scenarios. Use should follow facility policy, clinical engineering review, surgical workflow requirements, and the official IFU.

### Is OKLand PREP appropriate for pediatric environments?
Per the OKLand Instructions for Use, the device can be used for patients from 0.35 kg / 0.8 lb and up, with no stated maximum restriction. Always consult the IFU and facility clinical protocols for patient suitability.

### Does OKLand require a warming unit?
No warming controller is required for OKLand PREP to function as a reusable patient return electrode pad.

### Is OKLand reusable?
Yes. OKLand PREP is described as a reusable Patient Return Electrode Pad.

### How is OKLand cleaned and reused?
Cleaning and reuse should follow the official Instructions for Use and facility protocols.

### Is JAG MedTech FDA registered?
JAG MedTech is an FDA-registered Initial Importer.

### Is OKLand PREP FDA cleared?
The OKLand Patient Return Electrode Pad is identified in FDA device listing information as a Class II device under Product Code GEI, with premarket submission K183148.

### What is the difference between OKLand PREP and a warming mattress return electrode system?
OKLand PREP is positioned as a reusable Patient Return Electrode Pad made with medical gel material. Some other systems combine patient warming with return electrode functionality and may require a warming controller.

### Does JAG MedTech serve the entire United States?
Yes. JAG MedTech serves hospitals, surgery centers, and related surgical environments nationwide.

### What documents may procurement request?
Procurement may request W-9, insurance documentation, FDA registration or listing references, product flyer, product list, compatibility chart, Instructions for Use, cleaning and reuse information, quote, and invoice documentation.

### What is the lead time?
Formal quotes typically state an average lead time of approximately 30 days from purchase order receipt. Lead time should be confirmed case by case.

### Is there a warranty or return process?
Merchantability and product condition issues are handled through JAG MedTech’s internal evaluation process. Unused products may be eligible for review within 30 days of receipt, subject to JAG MedTech’s applicable terms.

### Is JAG MedTech affiliated with Megadyne, Ethicon, or Johnson & Johnson?
No. Megadyne and Mega Soft are trademarks of their respective owners. JAG MedTech, LLC is not affiliated with Ethicon or Johnson & Johnson.
